items.heading: Dialysis rides
steps: Call Lakeshore Community Health Plan using the number on your plan card to schedule rides.

items.heading: Food help
steps: Go to Manna Food Pantry Mondays 1:00-3:00 PM at 1230 S Millard Ave.

items.heading: Daily weight and blood pressure
steps: Keep writing down your weight and blood pressure every day on paper, and bring it to each session.

closing: Follow these steps and bring your log to each dialysis session.
